jobs_results.title: Data & Digital Business Operation Trainee
jobs_results.description:
Misión

Colaboración y apoyo transversal a nivel analítico, operacional y tecnológico al departamento de Data & Digital Business Operations (DDBO) con la finalidad de continuar desarrollando soluciones innovadoras que posibiliten la toma de decisiones estratégicas en la organización.

Responsabilidades
• Tareas de automatización y actualización de informes/tareas del departamento de CE (Ej: weekly sales, informes mayoristas, venta diaria, E-Tracking, etc.).
• Colaboración en el análisis y seguimiento de negocio de las principales marcas de Zambon (análisis ad-hoc).
• Participación activa en el diseño y creación de nuevos informes en Power BI.
• Mantenimiento y mejoras continuas de los informes de Power BI existentes.
• Desarrollo, formación y depuración del reporting generado en PowerBI.
• Colaboración en formaciones de reporting generado en Power BI a los diferentes usuarios internos de la compañía.
• Mantenimiento del DWH de compañía (SQL Server).
• Soporte en tareas de... mantenimiento del CRM (Sales Force).
• Colaboración en proyectos transversales del departamento.

Requerimientos del puesto

Formación y conocimientos:
• Formación universitaria relacionada con tecnologías o el análisis de datos.
• Conocimientos en el manejo de herramientas de visualización y análisis de datos (muy valorable Power Bi).
• Conocimientos de bases de datos y lenguaje SQL.
• Familiaridad en el uso de lenguajes de programación como Python o R, particularmente para tareas de manipulación y análisis de datos.
• Inglés – B2
• Se valorará experiencia relacionada con el área de Analítica de Datos, Gestión de Proyectos Tecnológicos y Transformación Digital

Competencias, valores y habilidades:
• Trabajo en equipo, proactividad, positivismo, compromiso, digital mindset, capacidad analítica, curiosidad
• Valores Zambon: integridad, honestidad, cuidado personal, modestia.
• Comportamientos Zambon: responsabilidad, innovación, enfoque, ambición.

Otros:
• Disponibilidad horaria completa de lunes a viernes.
• Permiso conducir y coche particular para desplazarse hasta Santa Perpetua de la Mogoda

jobs_results.title: Marketing Data & Analytics Manager
jobs_results.description:
We invite you to join Signify to bright future together, in a position where you can learn new things every day and thrive.

As a Global Data & Analytics Manager you will be part of the Digital Experience and Platforms Center of Excellence.

The team is responsible for developing and implementing the global omnichannel and personalization strategy across all related subdomains, including data collection, customer data platforms, and journey activation capabilities for both B2C and B2B brands. These strategies are deployed in over 50 countries. In this role, you will collaborate closely with other managers in our team and external stakeholders from business and IT departments to define the strategy for your domain and lead its execution, implementation, and adoption across various verticals.

To advance our goals, we are seeking a motivated and innovative Data expert. This individual will bring experience, fresh ideas, and creative thinking to enhance our marketing automation and... personalization efforts. The focus will be on generating business value, improving user experience, and maintaining exceptional product quality for leading lighting brands such as Philips Hue, WiZ, Signify, and Interact in both B2C and B2B markets.

What You’ll Do

Strategy Development
• Develop and execute a global Data Strategy and Insights Framework aligned with company objectives and business unit goals.
• Own the design of analytics models, performance measures, and strategic roadmaps.
• Standardize Data Collection strategy using server-side implementations to enhance first-party data collection.

Measurement, Reporting, and Data Collection
• Transition to server-side data processing to improve data integration with our Customer Data Platform (CDP) and third-party applications.
• Automate and standardize Digital Marketing reports & dashboards.
• Implement a self-service reporting strategy using existing tools (Adverity, Adobe Analytics, CJA).
• Develop a KPI Framework to measure commercial excellence and identify market opportunities.

Customer Experience Intelligence
• Oversee the management of Digital Experience and Commercial Data assets, ensuring data quality and accessibility.
• Support AI/ML model development to maximize customer data value.

Cross-functional Collaboration
• Provide strategic frameworks for leveraging customer data in targeted engagement initiatives.
• Ensure relevant data sources are integrated and available for decision-making.
• Develop global data platforms in collaboration with Global Platform & Architectural teams.

Change Management and Development
• Centralize governance of web analytics solutions and ensure data harmonization and quality across platforms.
• Implement robust data governance and change management processes.

Adoption and Stakeholder Engagement
• Partner with marketing teams to enhance the use of customer data for personalized marketing.
• Educate stakeholders on data-driven strategies and develop roadmaps to increase data acquisition and targeting capabilities.

Environment and R&D
• Act as the subject matter expert in Marketing Analytics, managing tag solutions like GTM and Adobe Launch and preparing for adjustments in a cookieless world.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• Data Availability
• Data Quality
• RFV Model
• Number of data-driven growth initiatives

Your Qualifications
• Comprehensive Business Understanding and Technical Acumen with proficiency in front-end technologies, digital analytics tools, and tag management solutions.
• Experience with data programming in SQL and/or Python.
• Proven leadership in driving business transformation and data-related roles.
• Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
• Master’s degree in Analytics, Information Management, or related field.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple projects.

What You’ll Get In Return…

We offer you a challenging, innovative, and creative environment in which you can rapidly grow your experience and career working for the leading lighting company where the innovation in LED and connected lighting make our work change rapidly. A unique place for highly skilled Digital Experts and Marketeers offering a unique possibility to drive growth in B2C as well as in B2B markets.

There will be multiple opportunities for career development, like mentoring, coaching and stretch assignments, with strong international exposure for dynamic profiles. Learning is fundamental to our culture. Through continuous learning, we are transforming the industry. You have the chance to learn every day, acquire new skills and perspectives through customized online programs, and on-the-job experiences.

See #SignifyLife through the eyes of our employees!

Who We Are

Signify is the world leader in lighting. We provide professional customers and consumers with quality, energy-efficient LED lighting. And our lights, when connected, bring data to devices, apps and people – redefining what light can do and how you use it. Today, our innovations, such as LiFi – internet connectivity through light – and UV-C, solar and horticultural lighting, contribute to a safer, smarter, more sustainable world. We’re operating in 74 countries with 32,000 people worldwide

jobs_results.title: Pricing & Sales Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
The mission of the Pricing Manager & Sales Data Analyst role is to analyze sales data comprehensively, provide insights into customer and regional trends, conduct pricing analysis, support sales forecasting activities, and maintain global price lists. This position plays a crucial role in optimizing sales strategies and maximizing profitability.

Job functions:
• Analyse sales data by clients and regions to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for growth.
• Conduct pricing analysis for products and clients to understand market positioning and identify potential areas for price optimization.
• Analyse ongoing offers and reporting in Sales Force to determine focus areas based on sales and margin.
• Define and maintain a global price list, including minimum prices by product, client, and region.
• Provide support in sales forecasting activities, including running forecasts and sales budgeting.
• Monitor and maintain the Commercial Status list on the Release SharePoint, including... quotes, quotes with samples, and no quotes.
• Reporting, track and analyse commercial KPIs such as lead time for samples, market share by OEM, market share for EV/PHEV, among others.
• Organize and report findings effectively, as this position operates globally and reports to the Chief Sales Officer (CSO).

Qualifications and competencies for the position:

University qualifications, Science or Engineering disciplines, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, with experience with technical products.

Further studies in sales valuable.

English & Spanish

Si eres un apasionado de los Datos y estás buscando nuevos retos profesionales, tenemos los proyectos que estás buscando.

Nuestra Comunidad Data & Analytics no para de crecer y necesitamos incorporar un equipo de ANALISTAS DE DATOS y/o CONSULTORES BI que estén listos para un nuevo desafío. Es necesaria experiencia trabajando con PowerBI.

Se podrá teletrabajar 100% en remoto.

¿Qué esperamos de ti?

¿Qué estamos buscando en ti?
• Experiencia mínima de 4 años en elaboración de informes en PowerBI.
• Conocimientos de modelado de datos DWH
• Modelado y limpieza de datos con Power Query.
• Elaboración y mantenimiento de informes.
• Comprobación de datos con SQL Server.
• Buenas experiencia en leguaje DAX.
• Valorable: Azure, Snowflake, DBT

¿Qué esperamos de ti?
• Autonomía y responsabilidad en la ejecución de tareas y compromisos.
• Dinamismo para abordar las tareas complejas.
• Proactividad para identificar mejoras y aplicar las mejores prácticas en sus soluciones.
• Analizar los... requerimientos de los proyectos por parte del cliente, y enfocarse en la parte de análisis y desarrollo de dashboards en Power BI.

Y además, que más te ofrecemos?

· 22 días de vacaciones, 2 días de libre disposición + 24 y 31 de Diciembre (cierre de empresa)

·Te podrás beneficiar de un completo programa de beneficios y descuentos (ocio, tecnología, bienestar y salud). ¿Quieres ejemplos? ·Acceso y formación en todo tipo de conocimiento técnico, habilidades o idiomas.

·Participación en eventos tecnológicos. Nosotros somos patrocinadores de eventos como el Codemotion, t3chfest y sobre todo estamos orgullosos de ser los organizadores de eventos técnicos como el blockchain spain y DevOps Spain.

·Nos acordamos de ti en los momentos importantes de tu vida (aniversario de trabajo, cumpleaños y nacimiento). ¡Tienes sorpresa asegurada!

·Vamos más allá del trabajo, por eso nos gusta organizar los Family days, para que te diviertas con tu familia en knowmad mood.

·Tienes acceso a nuestros meetups, techdays y a nuestro blog tecnológico ¿Todavía no conoces https://enmilocalfunciona.io/?

·Actividades de Teambuilding: Nos gusta divertirnos y estar en contacto con nuestros

Trabajamos en entornos agile, flexible, con máxima conciliación y teletrabajo y equipos horizontales de trabajo con una cultura de colaboración, compromiso e innovación.

En knowmad mood nos rodeamos de un buen ambiente y buena gente, donde se rema en la misma dirección para que todas las personas desarrollen su carrera profesional. Somos un ecosistema de talento y de oportunidades, podrás dirigir tu desarrollo profesional y tener conversaciones con tus responsables para localizar experiencias profesionales que consoliden tus nuevos conocimientos.

jobs_results.title: Progammatic Trader & Data Analyst. EMEA
jobs_results.description:
Who we are:

TAPTAP, founded in Madrid in 2010, is now present in 10 markets within Europe, Africa, and the Americas. Our clients are major multinational brands, media agencies and agency trading desks seeking data-driven branding solutions through digital channels.

TAPTAP developed its own technology and operates globally through Sonata Platform. What began as a premium mobile advertising network in 2010 has grown into a highly flexible global platform powered by location intelligence. The Sonata Platform by Taptap offers new possibilities for data-driven omnichannel media buying across the open web and advanced geospatial market analysis for 360° insight into your business.

Scope:

Reporting directly to the Head of Trading & Data Analyst, the candidate will play an important role within both the Client Services & the broader Commercial teams. The incumbent will take primary responsibility for the successful trafficking and optimization of all advertising data-driven digital... campaigns using TAPTAP’s proprietary DSP & DMP, Sonata.

The candidate will proactively manage campaigns booked by the EMEA Sales team, Branding or Tactical, whether sold directly, or programmatically ensuring all booked campaigns not just deliver in volume terms, but also exceed client expectations in terms of KPIs.

The candidate will work in close collaboration with the Product and Sales teams, and act as his/her interface with Sonata, to ensure that client Media programmatic revenues continue to grow across all Data-Driven Digital Strategies. The trader will be responsible for maintaining up-to-date forecasts of inventory availability, as well as providing ad hoc and regular reporting and recommendations on site, campaign and ad performance, sell-through and yield.

Responsibilities:
• Programming and Implementing Digital Media campaigns:
• Interface with agencies, trading desks and direct clients.
• Reviewing and processing advertising campaign material.
• Requiring plan assets, such as creatives and tracking tags.
• Setting up data-driven digital ad campaigns in Sonata.
• Managing bid strategies for campaigns.
• Operating across ad servers, ad technology solutions and Sonata’s DSP & DMP platform.
• Guaranteeing the campaign’s kick-off and deployment.
• Monitoring the Digital Media campaigns:
• Regularly monitor and reconcile campaign delivery across third party ad serving systems.
• Following-up daily on the campaign’s KPI’s, Analyze digital inventory to determine what is performing best for sponsors based on click-through rate, viewability, user engagement, and any other KPIs.
• Troubleshoot any ad creative issues that affect tracking, implementation, or reporting.
• Design and implement benchmarks according to performance or quality assurance KPIs.
• Have a daily contact with Tier 1 agencies and clients, ensuring client satisfaction acting as a technical ambassador for Taptap and its technologies, both for activation and planning of programmatic and DOOH campaigns ( using Sonata DSP, Sonata Location Intelligence tool).
• Optimizing the Digital media campaigns:
• Applying A/B testing on the creative pieces, targeting segments or media plans in order to improve the impact on the distinct audiences meeting campaign goals.
• Analyze and recommend campaign modifications, leveraging understanding of advertiser and product performance and any improvements to the strategic plan to increase stablished KPIs.
• Maximizing performance and ad revenue.
• Reporting:
• Providing campaign reports to internal teams and clients, using internal and third-party sources as needed.
• Elaborating the results and insights reports for our clients and partners.

Experience & Skills:
• 2-3 years of experience on similar position within a trading desk, publisher, advertiser adops/programmatic team.
• Knowledge of DSP/SSP technologies within the programmatic environment.
• Min 1 year of programmatic Buying experience on the demand side, with particular emphasis on Real Time Bidding.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and follow-up process.
• Strong initiative and ability to plan and prioritize work efficiently, multi-task, and work well under pressure with minimal direction.
• Data driven personality, ability to tell stories based on campaign data analysis.
• Excellent communication skills.
• Understanding of online and digital advertising metrics and KPIs.
• Advanced spreadsheet (Excel) capabilities.

Bonus points:
• Experience with analytics and BI tools like Looker, Power BI, Tableau,Google Analytics.
• HTML/Javascript knowledge.
• Fluent English (C1).
• Knowledge of Italian is a plus (B2)

Benefits:
• Permanent position based in Madrid (hybrid).
• Strong possibilities of internal promotion in an international firm.
• Competitive compensation package, according with the candidate´s profile & experience.
• Ticket Restaurant/Health Insurance
• Great working environment

• 2-3 years of experience on similar position within a trading desk, publisher, advertiser adops/programmatic team.

• Min 1 year of programmatic Buying experience on the demand side, with particular emphasis on Real Time Bidding.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and follow-up process.

• Data driven personality, ability to tell stories based on campaign data analysis.
• Excellent communication skills.
• Understanding of online and digital advertising metrics and KPIs.
• Advanced spreadsheet (Excel) capabilities.

• Experience with analytics and BI tools like Looker, Power BI, Tableau,Google Analytics.
• HTML/Javascript knowledge.
• Fluent English (C1).
• Knowledge of Italian is a plus (B2)

Benefits:
• Permanent position based in Madrid (hybrid).
• Strong possibilities of internal promotion in an international firm.

• Ticket Restaurant/Health Insurance
• Great working environment

jobs_results.title: Lead Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Who Are We?

Xcelirate - where we pride ourselves on being unapologetic tech innovators. We are committed to building products that we can truly be proud of, understanding that beauty goes beyond surface-level appearances. With a strong emphasis on tight security protocols, low latency, and an exceptional user experience, we are determined to shape the future of online entertainment.

As a community, we celebrate diversity, encompassing a wide range of nationalities, perspectives, and skill sets. When you join us, you'll become part of an energetic and motivated team that spans across the globe. We work hard, but we also know how to have fun.

Xcelirate is experiencing rapid growth and expansion. If you are a bright and talented individual who is up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you. Join us as we push boundaries and make a difference in the world of technology.

What are we looking for?

We are currently seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Lead who will play... a pivotal role in the product team, leading data analytics efforts to inform and guide product decisions. This role demands not only a hands-on approach to data analysis using SQL and Python but also an exceptional ability to translate technical findings into clear, business-friendly language. With a strong emphasis on digital B2C experience, the Data Lead will significantly contribute to the product strategy, directly impacting the success of the business and its products.

What will you be doing?
• Lead and actively engage in data analytics, ensuring high-quality data insights for product decision-making.
• Translate complex data analysis into concise, clear business language for effective communication with the product team.
• Hire, train, and manage a data analyst team, focusing on strong product understanding and technical skills.
• Develop and oversee quality assurance processes within the data team to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data outputs.
• Collaborate closely with the product and tech teams to align data analysis with product requirements and technical needs.

What you will bring along?
• A minimum of 10 years in hands-on data analysis, including at least 5 years in a leadership role, and 3 years as a data lead in a digital B2C environment.
• Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience in data visualization tools.
• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to effectively summarize data findings for the product team.
• Process-oriented, with the capability to implement and maintain quality assurance processes in data analysis.

How do we take care of our People?

💸 Highly Competitive Base Salary of 90,000€

🧘♀️ Up to 30% on top of your gross salary for wellness, personal growth, and development

🎮 Access to our award-winning Barcelona office complete with games, a fully stocked pantry and a stunning balcony with city views

🏝Annual company retreats to exotic destinations for you, your partner and children

⚽️ Watch FC Barcelona from our VIP Box

💆 In-office chair massages every week by our resident massage therapist

📖 Maximise growth with an annual learning budget for personalised development and regular sessions hosted by peers and industry experts

🌏 Seamless relocation package for a smooth transition for you and your family

🩺 Comprehensive health insurance with no copayment.

🍕 Indulge in daily catered breakfasts & lunches of your choice delivered to the office

💻 Elevate your workspace with high-quality equipment, premium branded merchandise, and all the essential fixtures for creating the perfect workstation

👩💻Access to a global network of co-working spaces

🗣 Enhance language skills with weekly business English classes and Spanish lessons

🎉 Enjoy exciting events from meals out, to music concerts and huge sporting events

Why You’ll Love Us:

Xcelirate is dedicated to helping people safely and securely find their perfect connection. We operate technologically-advanced platforms which are accessed by thousands of users every minute! We are proud to offer a workplace where the sharpest developers come together to strategically plan and swiftly execute practices which see us maintain our existing market dominance and attain global expansion. We owe our success to our customers who have seen us grow across a decade, and our talented team who have made that growth possible.

At Xcelirate, we’re committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We pride ourselves in being an equal opportunity workplace

jobs_results.title: Consultor/a Business Intelligence
jobs_results.description:
¡Nuestro equipo de Data en INETUM sigue creciendo! Buscamos incorporar CONSULTORES BI con los siguientes requisitos:

-Titulación mínima: Titulación universitaria o equivalente homologada en España.

-Experiencia mínima:
• Experiencia profesional de al menos 3 años en servicios, programas y proyectos TIC.
• Experiencia de más de 3 años en gestión de proyectos de implantación de sistemas a medida y módulo de datos Business Intelligence.
• Experiencia de más de 3 años en Metodología Business Intelligence y modelización de datos en entornos Data Warehouse, en diseño y creación de informes operativos, en herramientas relacionadas con el módulo de Business Intelligence, en el diseño y creación de Dashboards, informes y gráficos de modelos de analítica simple y avanzada y en tecnologías de desarrollo y control de versiones (GIT, RTC o similares).

-Amplio conocimiento en:
• Herramientas BI (como, por ejemplo: Cognos, PowerBI, SAP BI, Qlik y similares) .
• Elaboración de informes y... documentación de procesos, recopilación, transformación y carga (ETL) de datos, procedimientos de análisis e interpretación de resultados.
• Implementación de soluciones integrales BI.
• Bases de datos, modelizado, gestión, supervisión y análisis de datos.

Modalidad de trabajo: 100% presencial en las oficinas del cliente en Madrid capital.

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?:
• Retribución salarial acorde con la experiencia aportada
• Plan de carrera: ofrecemos una atractiva carrera profesional en función de la experiencia y potencial personal dentro de una compañía en continua evolución y con un sólido crecimiento
• Plan de formación en competencias tecnológicas de acuerdo con las exigencias de los proyectos y clientes.
• Retribución flexible: te ofrecemos una retribución a la carta pudiendo elegir diferentes productos y modelar tú mismo cómo distribuirlos: seguro de salud, tickets de comida, guardería, tarjeta transporte, etc.
• Flexibilidad horaria.

Sobre INETUM, A Positive Digital Flow:

Somos un consultora digital, internacional y ágil. En la era de la post-transformación digital, nos esforzamos para que cada uno de nuestros 28.000 profesionales pueda renovarse continuamente viviendo positivamente su propio flow digital. Nuestros 28.000 atletas digitales están orgullosos de haberse certificado Top Employer Europe 2024. Con su perfil multi-experto, Inetum ofrece a sus clientes una combinación única de proximidad, organización sectorial y soluciones de última generación. Presente en más de 27 países, el Grupo tiene cerca de 28.000 empleados y en 2023 generó unos ingresos de 2.400 millones de euros.

Únete a INETUM. Vive tu Positive Digital Flow

jobs_results.title: Language Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
TELUS International is looking for Language Data Analysts in Barcelona, Spain to work onsite for a machine learning project! At the moment, we are looking for candidates with fluency in Swedish or Dutch for a temporary vacancy of undefined duration.

Language Data Analysts will analyze data in a given language and identify potential issues. They will also collaborate with international testing teams and engineers to help reproduce issues and test features. Data obtained will be used to train and improve speech recognition and AI systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Includes, but is not limited to the following. Other duties may be assigned.
• Linguistic data labelling.
• Analyzing language data in the given language and identifying potential issues and patterns.
• Collaborating with an international testing team and engineers to help reproduce issues and test features.
• Communicating with various departments.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• Fluency in Swedish or Dutch .
• Preferred educational... background: linguistics, literature or translation.
• Available to work onsite in Barcelona, Spain.
• Excellent reading, writing and comprehension skills in English; ability to understand and closely follow elaborate guidelines in English.
• In-depth knowledge of native culture and history, staying up to date with day-to-day news and happenings in the target country and regular use of the language required.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet project targets.
• Self-motivated and able to work as part of the team or independently.
• Good computer and software skills across different operating systems.
• Strong typing skills.
• Good organizational skills
• Adaptable to changing environments.

WHAT WE OFFER:
• Fixed-term contract with TELUS International
• Meal vouchers
• Referral program with attractive bonuses
• Private medical insurance for employees and relatives
• Great office at a top location
• Positive international working environment (relaxing zones, terrace, kitchen)
• Discounts in gym memberships
• Career development opportunities
• No overtime or weekend work
• Continuous support and learning
• Access to counseling sessions

If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, apply now! Kindly attach your CV in English.
• Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

ABOUT US:

AI Data Solutions

Creating and enhancing the world's data to enable better AI via human intelligence.

We strive to enhance the world's data to enable better AI through human intelligence. Our team of data, technology, and project management professionals work with companies to test and improve machine learning models. We handle various data types, including text, images, audio, video, and geo. Our solutions improve AI systems in multiple applications, such as advanced smart products, improved search results, expanded speech recognition, more human-like bot interactions, and more.

TELUS International values diversity and grants equal opportunity regardless of age, civil status, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion and political beliefs, sex or sexual orientation.

Additional Job Description

TELUS International is looking for Language Data Analysts (various languages) in Barcelona, Spain.

EEO Statement

At TELUS International, we enable customer experience innovation through spirited teamwork, agile thinking, and a caring culture that puts customers first. TELUS International is the global arm of TELUS Corporation, one of the largest telecommunications service providers in Canada. We deliver contact center and business process outsourcing (BPO) solutions to some of the world's largest corporations in the consumer electronics, finance, telecommunications and utilities sectors. With global call center delivery capabilities, our multi-shore, multi-language programs offer safe, secure infrastructure, value-based pricing, skills-based resources and exceptional customer service - all backed by TELUS, our multi-billion dollar telecommunications parent.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS International, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity

jobs_results.title: Data & Martech Specialist
jobs_results.description:
¡ÚNETE A NUESTRO EQUIPO!

¿Te gustaría formar parte de la compañía española líder de bebidas de nuestro país y crear momentos de unión y conexión para mejorar la vida de las personas y del planeta? ¿Tienes Sed de Avanzar? ¡Ahora es tu oportunidad de demostrarlo!

Sobre nosotros

Somos una compañía familiar, líder de bebidas en España. Contamos con 10 centros de elaboración de cerveza –ocho en España y dos en Estados Unidos–, cuatro manantiales de agua y un equipo cercano a los 4.000 profesionales. Estamos presentes en más de 70 países.

Nuestro compromiso con el empleo de calidad y el bienestar de las personas, nuestros valores, nuestro propósito y nuestro espíritu innovador y transformador, desde hace más de 130 años, definen una forma única de hacer las cosas que nos permite avanzar hacia el futuro.

¿Por qué te estamos buscando?

Tu misión será colaborar en la identificación, desarrollo, implantación y seguimiento de herramientas de Martech así como del desarrollo de las políticas... de captura y gestión de uso de datos de consumidores, con el objetivo de consolidar el Ecosistema de Data de MSM y hacerlo accesible a toda la organización

Tu día a día en Mahou San Miguel

MARTECH
• Detectar las necesidades de Martech, propone la herramienta y realiza benchmarkcs de proveedores para su desarrollo.
• Impulsar el desarrollo del ecosistema data cookieless y eRetail con el objetivo de generar audiencias para PAID MEDIA.
• Colaborar, junto con el Manager, en la implementa las herramientas y el diseño de casos de uso
• Colaborar en la definición y coordinación del modelo de governance relacionado con Martech

DATA
• Colaborar en la definición de las políticas de captura, gestión y uso de los datos de consumidor, dando soporte a la definición de los procesos de implementación
• Colaborar en la activación de audiencias generadas desde BBDD MSM (i.e., 1st party data)
• Impulsa el uso del dato en la organización y da apoyo en la consolidación del ecosistema de Data y medición, haciéndolo fácilmente accesible por toda la organización
• Participar en la definición del dashboard que permita el seguimiento y la visualización para toda la compañía de los datos obtenidos de todos los puntos de contacto con consumidores y clientes
• Colaborar con el Hub Conocimiento en la explotación de la información y participa en la definición de los casos de uso de dato: trabajo en conjunto identificando las mejores formas de explotar el ecosistema así como la ideación de nuevos casos de uso que puedan permitir la obtención de nueva información relevante

¿Qué requisitos debes cumplir?
• Grado universitario en ADE o Empresariales.
• Nivel B2.2 de inglés
• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en proyectos de Martech
• Experiencia en desarrollo de proyectos centrados en data con herramientas de Salesforce, LiveRamp, AWS.
• Experiencia en la elaboración de dashboard y/o en la utilización de cuadros de mando en Tableau
• Conocimiento y capacidades de data analytics
• Entendimiento y conocimiento digital
• Conocimiento de herramientas de IT y digitales
• Experiencia y entendimiento de metodologías “agile”

La diversidad, clave en nuestra estrategia

Nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de oportunidades está presente desde nuestro nacimiento en 1890. Nuestra visión, en este sentido, es “construir el futuro a través de la suma de personas únicas, impulsando la diversidad de forma activa como fuente de riqueza en la sociedad”.

Por eso, esta oferta está dirigida a cualquier persona que reúna los requisitos exigidos para el puesto, independientemente de sus características

• Colaborar en la activación de audiencias generadas desde BBDD MSM (i.e., 1st party data)
• Impulsa el uso del dato en la organización y da apoyo en la consolidación del ecosistema de Data y medición, haciéndolo fácilmente accesible por toda la organización
• Participar en la definición del dashboard que permita el seguimiento y la visualización para toda la compañía de los datos obtenidos de todos los puntos de contacto con consumidores y clientes
• Colaborar con el Hub Conocimiento en la explotación de la información y participa en la definición de los casos de uso de dato: trabajo en conjunto identificando las mejores formas de explotar el ecosistema así como la ideación de nuevos casos de uso que puedan permitir la obtención de nueva información relevante

¿Qué requisitos debes cumplir?
• Grado universitario en ADE o Empresariales.
• Nivel B2.2 de inglés
• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en proyectos de Martech
• Experiencia en desarrollo de proyectos centrados en data con herramientas de Salesforce, LiveRamp, AWS.
• Experiencia en la elaboración de dashboard y/o en la utilización de cuadros de mando en Tableau
• Conocimiento y capacidades de data analytics
• Entendimiento y conocimiento digital
• Conocimiento de herramientas de IT y digitales
• Experiencia y entendimiento de metodologías “agile”

La diversidad, clave en nuestra estrategia

Nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de oportunidades está presente desde nuestro nacimiento en 1890. Nuestra visión, en este sentido, es “construir el futuro a través de la suma de personas únicas, impulsando la diversidad de forma activa como fuente de riqueza en la sociedad”.

Por eso, esta oferta está dirigida a cualquier persona que reúna los requisitos exigidos para el puesto, independientemente de sus características
